article.headline: Brownell has 18 in Samford's 77-61 win against Wofford
article.description: — Jaden Brownell had 18 points in Samford's 77-61 win against Wofford on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Brownell has 18 in Samford's 77-61 win against Wofford
article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Jaden Brownell had 18 points in Samford's 77-61 win against Wofford on Saturday night. Brownell added five rebounds for the Bulldogs (17-4, 7-1 Southern Conference). Lukas Walls scored 12 points, going 4 of 6 and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line. Rylan Jones went 4 of 9 from the field (2 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 11 points. Corey Tripp led the way for the Terriers (11-10, 5-3) with 15 points. Jeremy Lorenz added 14 points for Wofford. Kyler Filewich also recorded 12 points, eight rebounds, two steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
